# Payment retries
QuasarRecovery must reuse the original idempotency key when retrying a payment. A new key can create a duplicate charge. The duplicate-charge regression passed for the observed revision.
queries: QuasarRecovery retry policy

Why reuse the idempotency key?
Cómo evitar cobros duplicados al reintentar pagos
What prevents charging a customer twice?

# Refresh token rotation
Rotate refresh tokens once per session renewal. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the token family. Do not log token contents.
queries: refresh token rotation
What happens when an old refresh token is reused?
Can I log credentials while debugging authentication?
Renovar sesión sin exponer tokens
How should a stolen renewal credential be handled?

# Database migrations
Database schema migrations run in a transaction. Add nullable columns first, backfill existing rows, then introduce NOT NULL. Never delete production data to repair a failed migration.
queries: database schema migration
When can we introduce NOT NULL?
What is the backfill order?
Cómo agregar una columna obligatoria sin perder datos
Can a failed migration delete production data?

# Time handling
Persist event timestamps in UTC. Render local time using the user time zone. Cordoba and Buenos Aires use the America/Argentina time zone identifiers. Do not store formatted display strings as timestamps.
queries: UTC event timestamps
How should local time be rendered?
Argentina Cordoba time zone
Dónde guardar fechas y cómo mostrarlas al usuario
Should a formatted display date be stored?

body:
# Cache invalidation
Invalidate the customer cache after a committed profile update. A failed transaction must leave the previous cached value usable. Cache keys include the tenant identifier.
queries: customer cache invalidation
When does a profile update invalidate the cache?
tenant identifier cache keys
Una transacción fallida debe borrar la caché
Could customer data leak across organizations?

body:
# Run journal
Persist tool intent before dispatching a workspace write. Persist the tool result before continuing the agent loop. On interruption, unknown tool outcomes require inspecting state instead of blindly replaying side effects.
queries: tool intent dispatch durability
What happens after an interrupted workspace write?
unknown tool outcomes
Cómo recuperar una tarea interrumpida sin repetir cambios
Why persist tool results before continuing?

body:
# Workspace isolation
A subagent worktree owns its own workspace root. Relative writes and memory notes resolve inside that assigned worktree. Never silently fall back to the parent checkout.
queries: subagent worktree workspace root
Where do relative memory writes go?
parent checkout fallback
Aislar cambios y memoria entre ramas de trabajo
Can a child task modify the main checkout?

body:
# Keyboard accessibility
Dialogs trap keyboard focus while open and restore focus to the invoking control when closed. Escape dismisses nonblocking dialogs. Icon-only controls require accessible labels.
queries: dialog keyboard focus
What should Escape do in a dialog?
accessible labels icon controls
Restaurar foco al cerrar una ventana de diálogo
How can keyboard users navigate the interface?

body:
# Revision conflicts
Memory updates require the current revision and content hash. Unsaved editor buffers block background replacement. Two native clients serialize mutations through one owner to avoid losing a write.
queries: memory revision content hash
Why did an unsaved editor buffer block a memory write?
two native clients serialize mutations
Evitar perder notas cuando escriben dos agentes
How do we protect concurrent updates?

body:
# Test fixtures
Integration tests use a deterministic local HTTP provider and disposable workspaces. Tests must verify observable disk effects and restart recovery. A provider stub does not establish real-model memory quality.
queries: deterministic local HTTP provider
Why use disposable workspaces in integration tests?
restart recovery disk effects
Qué prueban las fixtures y qué queda sin medir
Does a stub prove semantic retrieval quality?
